Background: the branch makes the agent loop fail with `AgentError::ToolCallsNotRun` instead of running tool calls from a turn that ended with Length/ContentFilter or with no Finish. On a user cancel, the core driver (agent.rs ~1520) now returns with no terminal event, and runtime-tokio's `controlled()` turns that into `RunError::Cancelled`.

## Findings to fix (verbatim from the reviewer, condensed)

I1. "A direct `Agent::run` consumer and `agent_as_tool` now see a cancel as a success. agent.rs:1520 early return with no terminal event; `RunResultStreaming::collect` (runner.rs:421) then returns Ok(RunResult { stop_reason: Completed, final_output: "" }). In `agent_as_tool` (crates/paigasus-helikon-core/src/agent_as_tool.rs:158-195), a cancelled sub-agent gives the parent `ToolOutput("")`, which reads as a successful tool call; the recorder can hold a `ToolReturned ""` that `finalize` writes to the session, and a later run sends it to the model as a real answer. Fix: in `agent_as_tool`, when `ctx.cancel().is_cancelled()` and `result.events` has no terminal event, return a `ToolError`. Add one sentence to the core CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` and one sentence to the 'The event stream' section of docs/book/src/concepts/agent-loop.md: a cancelled run can end its stream with no terminal event; a runner such as TokioRunner reports it as `RunError::Cancelled`, and a direct `collect` of `Agent::run` gives `Ok`."
   → Implement the agent_as_tool fix with a test (write first, record RED): a sub-agent whose model sends a complete tool call and, on cancel, ends with no Finish; cancel; assert the parent tool returns an error (not Ok("")). Find agent_as_tool's existing tests (grep in crates/paigasus-helikon-core/tests and src) and follow them. Choose the ToolError variant that the crate already uses for a cancel or abort, if one exists; say which.

I2. "The Temporal driver test does not check which failure it got. crates/paigasus-helikon-runtime-temporal/src/driver.rs:696-699 matches `ErrorKindPayload::Other { .. }`. Fix: bind `message` and assert that it holds `\"not run\"` and `\"Length\"`." → Check the real Display text in agent.rs first and pick substrings that are in it.

I3. "The core CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` bullet 3 claim 'On Temporal, the error arrives as `AgentError::Other` with the same text' is true only when the cut turn's arguments parse. On Temporal, a Length/ContentFilter turn with partial JSON fails in the `call_model` activity with the reassembly text (activities.rs:110 maps it to Other, non-retryable); a no-Finish turn fails with the accumulator text. Fix: add to the core CHANGELOG and the runtime-temporal CHANGELOG: 'If the tool call arguments are not complete JSON, or the stream has no `Finish`, the `call_model` activity fails with the reassembly text.'" → Verify against activities.rs before you write it.

M1. Core upgrade note: name "an OpenAI-compatible server that sends no `finish_reason`" as one example of a stream with no Finish (openai chat backend chat.rs:519-528 emits no Finish then).
M2. agent.rs ~1511-1522: the code records `chat_span` and `run_span` as "ERROR" before the cancel check. Move the `is_cancelled()` check above the two `record` calls.
M3. crates/paigasus-helikon-core/tests/tool_calls_not_run.rs:130-137 `cut_call_is_not_recorded_in_the_session` can pass vacuously. Add a positive assert that the log is not empty (for example a user-message event is present — use the real SessionEvent variant name).
M4. model.rs:780 long doc line — wrap it; model.rs:797-801 duplicates `tool_call_names()` — call `self.tool_call_names()` instead (before `self` is moved).

All prose in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English (max 25 words per descriptive sentence, active voice, no idioms, keep articles).

- Tests first where a test applies (I1, I2, M3), record RED where meaningful (I1).
- Run: `cargo test -p paigasus-helikon-core --test tool_calls_not_run`, the agent_as_tool tests, `cargo test -p paigasus-helikon-core --lib`, `cargo test -p paigasus-helikon-runtime-temporal --lib`, `cargo test -p paigasus-helikon-runtime-tokio`; then `cargo fmt --all`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc -p paigasus-helikon-core --no-deps`, `npx markdownlint-cli2` on changed .md files, `mdbook build docs/book` (remove any untracked output).
